# spec: Side Direction Indicator

## Product Type

Side direction indicator (side repeater) — compact signalling lamp mounted on the front fender, indicating an intended change of direction to road users beside the vehicle.

## Vehicle Category

M1 — passenger car. UNECE lighting regulations referenced apply across M and N categories.

## Function

- Direction indication to the side (amber, flashing)
- Hazard warning signal (simultaneous operation with all direction indicators)
- Light transmission & color definition (outer lens)

## Main Parts

- Outer lens
- Housing
- LED light source on PCB
- Inner reflector
- Gasket
- Connector
- Retaining clip

## Materials

Representative values — confirm against actual bill of materials.


| Component         | Typical material(s)                         |
| ----------------- | ------------------------------------------- |
| Outer lens        | PMMA (amber-tinted, UV-stabilised)          |
| Housing           | ABS or ASA                                  |
| Inner reflector   | PC with aluminium vacuum-metallised coating |
| Light source      | Amber LEDs on FR4 PCB                       |
| Gasket            | EPDM or TPE                                 |
| Connector         | PBT-GF30, tin-plated brass contacts         |
| Retaining clip    | POM or spring steel                         |

## Electrical

- Nominal voltage: 12 V DC
- Flash frequency: 90 ± 30 flashes per minute (controlled by vehicle body control module)
